_about: Community pool: a typology definition the general engine reads (format:, approved project decision, 13 Nov 2026). Source of every figure: the pool spec (Parts 1-3, 6) and (13 Nov), with the register ids they cite. Areas in m2, lengths in m. Written by Code 14 Nov 2026 from those files; nothing here is new.
name: Community pool

upper.src: empty since 17z (no upstairs public program until stacking option 1)

family.src: band order: spec rule 1; positions and the 8.1 m wet band, 5.2 m lobby and 3.2 m chemical column are drawing choices read from the V339 pool board (CP-13d), named here so the engine reads them, not new rules; viewing_gallery added to the wet band (beside the hall, behind glass) by project decision, 17 Nov 15:02 ( item 6): drawn when there is room, dropped at ladder step 5 with the gym (rank 3); 18 Nov ( item 2): gym and gym storage moved from family.upper into the at-grade strip list (rank 3, after the required rooms), so the family places them at grade wherever the ground floor holds them (beside layouts: with the strip rooms; stacked: in the front strip) and ladder step 5 drops them otherwise; CPprog's fill hook stays the fallback for leftover pieces

rooms.name: Pool hall (25 m, 4 lanes, 1.8 m deck)
rooms.src: spec 1a: tank 25 x 8.5 m (arch_sportEngPoolsDGN, arch_sportEngPoolsApp1); deck >= 1.8 m all round (arch_sup_nbcAE7Pools 7.2.3.15.(1)(a); Vancouver: our extension); clear height >= 3.5 m (arch_sportEngPoolsDGN p. 23); drawn 12.3 x 28.8 m (POOL_VARIANTS 2)

tank.inHall: clear rectangle of the hall (12.1 x 28.6 m minimum) inset by the 1.8 m deck on all four sides; long side along the hall length
tank.drawn: the boards draw the hall 12.3 x 28.8 m to centrelines and the tank 25.0 x 8.65 m (fixtures POOL_TANK is plan-frame [x0, x1, y0, y1])

rooms.waterSrc: 25 m x 4 lanes x 8.5 m = 212.5 m2 (spec 1a; arch_sportEngPoolsApp1: lanes >= 2.0 m, project decision, 9 Nov). deepM2 70.8 m2: the water 1.5 m or deeper, the last 8.33 m of the 0.9 to 1.8 m profile over 25 m x 8.5 m Part 1a, drawing-choice profile); used by Vancouver (BC Guidelines 8.7), not by Edmonton (7.2.4.1 counts all water)
rooms.bathersSrc: bathers from waterM2 / deepM2 by the code formula (C4C5.bathers / C5): Edmonton 1.5 m2 a bather (NBC(AE) 7.2.4.1), Vancouver deep / 2.5 + shallow / 0.93 (BC Guidelines 8.7); project decision, 17 Nov 15:02 ( item 2)

rooms.name: Change room, women (dressing, showers, WCs)

rooms.perPersonSrc: the people in this room are the bathers already counted from the water area in the hall (BC Guidelines 8.7; NBC(AE) 7.2.4.1); counting them again by floor area would double the load; no floor density

rooms.name: Hypochlorite store (liquid sodium hypochlorite; replaces the chlorine gas room)
rooms.src: spec 1a and rule 9: NBC(AE) 7.2.3.45; STANDATA 19-BCI-008; size 6-9 m2 drawing choice | Entered from outside only (project decision, 16 Nov 07:39): outward door to the outside and no door or operable window into the building; AB 7.2.3.45; STANDATA 19-BCI-008 (spec Part 1 chlorine row) | project decision, 16 Nov 09:10 (sourced 09:30): disinfection by liquid sodium hypochlorite, BC Guidelines for Pool Design 2025 s. 9.2 (precedent Nanaimo Aquatic Centre, Beban Park); ventilated to outside, tanks bunded to 110 % of the largest (s. 9.9), wall between it and the acid store, separate fill points, injected before the acid; the gas-room door rules (outside-only door, 1 h gas-tight, 5 m zone) no longer apply: outside delivery door where it fits, an inside door to the pool plant allowed; size from tank count and delivery interval (assumption: two day tanks, monthly delivery; no sourced size); Edmonton: NBC(AE) 7.2.3.45 is gas-only, (not yet checked) read the NBC(AE) chemical storage clauses | 17 Nov ( item 1): minimum 8 m2, E6's need for a store serving a pool hall (patches/E6: hypochlorite minM2 8.0, acid 8.0 with a pool hall; BC Guidelines for Pool Design 2025 s. 9.2, 9.9); was 6 (drawing choice)
rooms.doorRule: outside delivery door where it fits; an inside door to the pool plant allowed (16 Nov)
